claim: Under the condition of in-flow boundary data as a small perturbation of a global Maxwellian, the steady Boltzmann equation with in-flow boundary condition converges to the incompressible Navier-Stokes-Fourier system with Dirichlet boundary condition.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by numerically solving the steady Boltzmann equation with in-flow boundary data set as a small perturbation of a global Maxwellian and verifying that the solution approaches the incompressible Navier-Stokes-Fourier system with Dirichlet boundary condition in the hydrodynamic limit.

conditions: in-flow boundary data is a small perturbation of a global Maxwellian
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the steady Boltzmann equation with in-flow boundary condition and the specific perturbation condition studied; transfer beyond these conditions is unestablished.

title: Steady Boltzmann equation–convergence to the incompressible theorem
